technicalTruthHero.headline: Automated table assignment with adjacency, holds, and conflict checks
technicalTruthHero.subheadline: The booking pipeline validates capacity, slack budget, zone, movable-table rules, adjacency, and conflicts/holds, then attempts inline auto-assign and schedules background retries if confirmation is still pending.
technicalTruthHero.keyStat: Default table holds lock inventory for 180 seconds (3 minutes).

featuresGrid.operationalBenefit: Seat guests without double-booking by seeing held, conflicted, and assigned tables at a glance.
featuresGrid.technicalDetail: `TableFloorPlan` renders per-table holds/conflicts with countdownSeconds and supports an only-available view to hide blocked tables.

featuresGrid.operationalBenefit: Run service flow faster with check-in, check-out, and no-show actions tied to the live booking list.
featuresGrid.technicalDetail: Lifecycle actions use optimistic updates with conflict handling and an offline queue so staff can keep moving even during connectivity blips.

featuresGrid.operationalBenefit: Recognize repeat guests, prioritize VIPs, and respect marketing opt-ins without digging through spreadsheets.
featuresGrid.technicalDetail: `OpsCustomer` tracks totalBookings, totalCovers, lastBookingAt, and marketingOptIn; bookings include loyaltyTier, allergies, dietaryRestrictions, and seatingPreference.

featuresGrid.operationalBenefit: Visualize service windows and keep every table's status accurate for smoother turn planning.
featuresGrid.technicalDetail: Timeline segments are typed as reserved/hold/available/out_of_service with lunch/dinner services; table inventory stores category, seatingType, mobility, and status.

workflow.input: Bookings enter via POST /api/bookings (public reserve widget) or ops walk-ins flagged with x-ops-walk-in headers, including party size, time, and contact info.
workflow.processing: Requests are schema-validated, rate-limited (60/min per restaurant + IP), capacity-checked, and persisted; inline auto-assign runs with a bounded timeout and falls back to background auto-assign with holds and conflict checks.
workflow.output: The API returns the booking plus confirmation token; OpsBookingsClient and the BookingStateMachine refresh lists via React Query and show status transitions, while the floor plan highlights assigned, held, or conflicted tables.

faq.objection: What if the internet goes down?
faq.answer: The booking offline queue captures actions and the offline banner shows queued items; when connectivity returns, queued mutations can sync automatically or on demand.
Multi-table assignments are supported with capacity, slack, zone, adjacency, and movable-table checks; the allocator max tables per booking is configurable (FEATURE_ALLOCATOR_K_MAX, 1-5).
Ops surfaces use focused dialogs and status badges, plus global shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+N to add tables) to speed up common tasks.
